_readme: Strings shared by every page (G Pen Core layer). build.py merges these under each page's own translations, so a guide's i18n/<slug>.json wins on any key both define. Hand-written, not generated by gen_i18n.py; wording matches the terms already used in the guide translations (e.g. the specs 'type' rows). cat_<slug> = the product category shown on the index cards and in the All-guides switcher.
